spine.body: Midnight launch, New Zealand first. Metacritic 99 from 150+ reviews, tied best ever. 15.9m pre-orders, $1.54bn. $79.99, PS5/Xbox, no PC.
spine.headline: GTA VI is out today

spine.body: Russia struck the capital in the early hours; four wounded in the region, energy grid hit in Odesa.
spine.headline: Drones strike Kyiv overnight

spine.body: Third strike in four days: Neptune missiles hit the railway section overnight, halting trains to Crimea.
spine.headline: Kerch rail bridge hit again

spine.body: The college exam runs 08:40–17:45; flights pause for the listening test and offices open late.
spine.headline: 551,864 sit Korea's Suneung exam

spine.body: After 18 years, parliament lets the state seize corruption-linked assets over Rp1bn without a conviction first.
spine.headline: Indonesia passes asset-seizure law

spine.body: 9–6: Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, the first such verdict against a state. Reparations ordered; 730,000+ fled in 2017.
spine.headline: ICJ: Myanmar guilty of genocide

spine.body: Ministers haggle in Antalya over the draft deal — fossil-fuel phaseout, adaptation finance — before Friday's close.
spine.headline: COP31 enters final 48 hours

spine.body: Opened at $111.50, +34% on its $83 IPO price, briefly topping $2tn. Closed at $97.17, +17%. The $81.3bn sale is the largest IPO ever.
spine.headline: Anthropic opens at $111.50

spine.body: First-ever trilateral, 90 minutes at Kylin Villa. A four-point 'Declaration toward Peace': UN reform, oil, nuclear talks, ICC limits. No word on Ukraine.
spine.headline: Trump, Xi, Putin issue declaration

spine.body: Parliament unanimously approves the US–Greenland security deal: more US bases, missile defence, sovereignty kept.
spine.headline: Denmark votes 109–0 for Arctic pact

spine.body: Bears down on Odisha and Andhra Pradesh; landfall Friday noon. Winds 90–100 km/h; red alert in 10 districts.
